title: freesecdev.linux_compliance exceptions file, schema version 1.0
description: Version-controlled exceptions (waivers) for compliance findings. The schema describes the document as the collection's strict YAML loader reads it, in which every scalar is a string. Rules that JSON Schema cannot express are enforced by plugins/module_utils/compliance/exceptions.py and documented in docs/exceptions.md: identifiers are unique ignoring case, created is not in the future, approval.date lies between created and today and before expires, expires is after created by at most 365 days, and the approver is not the owner.

date.description: A calendar date in UTC, YYYY-MM-DD.

person.description: An email address or a handle such as platform-team, in lowercase ASCII. The collection also accepts other case and NFKC-equivalent forms and folds them to this canonical form before comparing owner and approver.

id.description: Stable identifier of the exception, unique in the file ignoring case.

rule.description: Full XCCDF rule identifier, for example xccdf_org.ssgproject.content_rule_sshd_disable_root_login.

framework.description: The framework whose control the exception is granted against. Recorded and reported; it does not restrict matching.

justification.description: Why the risk is accepted, including compensating controls.

scope.description: Where the exception applies. Every dimension that is present must match; within a list, one entry is enough. A benchmark scope also needs profiles, because the profiles of one benchmark share its identifier.

profiles.description: Full XCCDF profile identifiers, matched exactly against the profile of the scan run.

groups.description: Inventory group names (group_names), matched exactly. The implicit groups all and ungrouped are not allowed.

benchmark.description: The XCCDF benchmark and the content version of the scan run.
